title: The Line Set: Holding Instruments Apart
description: The selected deposit is a 248-page collected volume whose cover names nine works; the canonical registry citation remains The Line Set: Holding Instruments Apart. Its opening Line Set work describes eight instruments and a reader that checks declared vocabulary collisions through resolve, bind, collide, declare and status stages. SET_LEGIBLE concerns non-overlapping declared names under exemptions, not conceptual independence, correctness, completeness or behavioral efficacy. The other collected works retain their own scopes; this catalog refresh does not reclassify the volume as nine new bibliography entries.
